nodes.title: The Studio generation approval lane closes after round 3 (main, 2026-11-11 13:22): 13 of the 34 scripted topics have a two-judge approved game, 7 have no game target, and 14 are refused. $0.175 spent on generation, 8.32M judge tokens. Yield fell from 6/22 in round 2 to 2/18 in round 3; what remains is missed mix-ups and engine limits that no prompt hint fixes. Table: docs/design/round7/studio/approval-lane-close-2026-11-11.md. Reverse, one topic at a time and never in rounds, when an engine gains the capability its no-game entry names or Games' families cover the topic with an executable mal-rule.

A word that mixes Latin and Devanagari letters ("Tribhuज") is refused in every engine: an approve-check predicate, and a refusal at generation before any paid check (mixed_script). No catalogue or stored spec (398 files) has one. Reverse only if a deliberate mixed-script word is ever wanted (none known).
